decisions.reason: As a distant and narrow niche relative to the core lighting portfolio, submarine interior lighting offers limited spillovers and after several years likely no longer justifies keeping this option open.
Explosion-proof luminaires fit the firm's industrial customer base and LED strategy, and the added 2019 replacement kit signals enough positive learning to continue supporting the line.
The relaunched designer task light is close to the established offer and its prior popularity lowers downside risk, so the firm would likely keep it unless performance clearly weakens.
A pendant office luminaire sits squarely in the firm's core commercial lighting business, where growth and strategic fit make continued market presence a reasonable low-cost option.

The premium pendant luminaire is still close to the core range and worth keeping, though its more premium positioning makes it somewhat more vulnerable to later portfolio pruning if demand proves limited.
